SignInComplete.note: Success tone: green status chip, brand mark + wordmark, hero title, detail line and a primary/secondary action pair. The component's min-h-screen is overridden with h-full min-h-0 so it sits in a window-sized frame.

CallbackFailed.note: Error tone with a destructive chip, the failure explanation, an error/request-id detail line and Try again / Contact support.

Exchanging.note: Neutral in-flight state: muted chip, no actions, the living mark still breathing.

DesktopHandoff.note: variant=handoff: mark leads, no status chip, single full-width h-11 action — a visibly different layout from the default variant.
